b1-revolucioncubana-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Cuba Before the Revolution
b1-revolucioncubana-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about Cuba in the 1950s, and he asks what life was like for the sugar workers.
b1-revolucioncubana-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the sugar workers used to do.
cues: Say what the sugar workers used to do
b1-revolucioncubana-01.target: Los trabajadores del azúcar solían trabajar solo durante la zafra.
b1-revolucioncubana-01.english: The sugar workers used to work only during the harvest.
b1-revolucioncubana-01.canDo: I can say how Cuba became a republic and what influence the United States had.

b1-revolucioncubana-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rebels
b1-revolucioncubana-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about the Cuban revolution, and he asks what the rebels had done when Batista fled.
b1-revolucioncubana-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the rebels had already done.
cues: Say what the rebels had already won
b1-revolucioncubana-02.target: Cuando Batista huyó, los rebeldes ya habían ganado importantes batallas.
b1-revolucioncubana-02.english: When Batista fled, the rebels had already won important battles.
b1-revolucioncubana-02.canDo: I can say what happened at the Moncada barracks in 1953.

b1-revolucioncubana-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Socialist Revolution
b1-revolucioncubana-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg were in a class about the Cuban revolution, and she asks what happened to the relations between Cuba and the United States.
b1-revolucioncubana-03.prompt: Tell Meg how the relations changed.
cues: Say that Cuba got closer to the Soviet Union
Say how the distrust of the United States grew
b1-revolucioncubana-03.target: Cuanto más se acercaba Cuba a la Unión Soviética, más grande era la desconfianza de Estados Unidos.
b1-revolucioncubana-03.english: The closer Cuba got to the Soviet Union, the greater was the distrust of the United States.
b1-revolucioncubana-03.canDo: I can describe the agrarian reform law of 1959.

b1-revolucioncubana-04.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Edge of War
b1-revolucioncubana-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about October 1962, and he asks what the world nearly saw.
b1-revolucioncubana-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what the world almost did in October 1962.
cues: Say that it happened in October 1962
Say what the world nearly entered
b1-revolucioncubana-04.target: En octubre de 1962 el mundo estuvo a punto de entrar en una guerra nuclear.
b1-revolucioncubana-04.english: In October 1962 the world came close to entering a nuclear war.
b1-revolucioncubana-04.canDo: I can say who landed at the Bay of Pigs and what happened.

b1-revolucioncubana-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Cuba and the OAS
b1-revolucioncubana-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg were in a class about the Cuban revolution, and she asks what happened to Cuba in the OAS in 1962.
b1-revolucioncubana-05.prompt: Tell Meg what was done to Cuba in 1962.
cues: Say what was done to Cuba
b1-revolucioncubana-05.target: En 1962 Cuba fue suspendida de la OEA.
b1-revolucioncubana-05.english: In 1962 Cuba was suspended from the Organization of American States (OAS).
b1-revolucioncubana-05.canDo: I can say how young people and governments reacted to the Cuban revolution.

b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Cuban Revolution: A Summary
b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just finished a unit on the Cuban revolution, and he asks you for a short summary of how it began.
b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos how things were before the revolution and what had happened when Batista fled.
cues: Say what the sugar workers used to do
Say what the rebels had already done when Batista fled
b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.target: Los trabajadores del azúcar solían trabajar solo durante la zafra. Cuando Batista huyó, los rebeldes ya habían ganado importantes batallas.
b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.english: The sugar workers used to work only during the harvest. When Batista fled, the rebels had already won important battles.
b1-revolucioncubana-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up how things were in Cuba before the revolution and how it began.
